chapter.heading: Psalm 150
Let Everything Praise the LORD
chapter.v:
Praise the
LORD! Praise,
God in his sanctuary; praise him in his mighty heavens!(1)

Praise him
with trumpet,
sound; praise him with lute and harp!

Praise him
with tambourine,
and dance; praise him with strings and pipe!

Praise him
with sounding,
cymbals; praise him with loud clashing cymbals!

Let everything
that has,
breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD! Footnotes (1) 150:1 Hebrew *expanse* (compare Genesis 1:6–8) (ESV)
